# Feedback (Apple Human Interface Guidelines)

**Page:** https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/feedback  
**Where:** [Human Interface Guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines) › [Patterns](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/patterns) › Feedback  
**Parent skill:** `/hig-patterns`  
**Platforms:** iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, watchOS.

## How to use this skill

1. Read the page as it is today; don't work from memory. From the repository root:
   `python3 .claude/skills/hig/scripts/hig_page.py feedback`
   For one section: `python3 .claude/skills/hig/scripts/hig_page.py feedback --section <anchor>`, with an anchor from the list below.
2. Apply it to the task. The guidelines are written for Apple's frameworks; the PDM app is Expo / React Native, so translate each rule with [the hig skill's Expo notes](../hig/expo.md) and keep to [docs/frontend](../../../docs/frontend/README.md) (UI system, accessibility, platform adapters).
3. Cite the section link for every rule you apply and every finding you report.
